# Cartridge — development / test dependencies
#
# Install on top of requirements.txt:
#   python -m pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
#
# The *test suite itself* only needs pytest. Everything else is optional tooling:
#   - vermin: proves the source tree stays Python 3.8 compatible (CI/lint aid).
#   - pillow: NOT required. Image fixtures are generated by tests/_png.py
#     (pure stdlib zlib/struct) and by Qt's QImage, so the suite stays
#     dependency-light and offline-safe.
#
# Version floors below are the newest releases that still install on Python 3.8.
# On a 3.8 interpreter pip will resolve these automatically; on newer
# interpreters it will pick newer releases, which is fine for development.

-r requirements.txt

pytest>=6.2,<8            # pytest 8.x dropped Python 3.8 support
vermin>=1.5,<2            # static minimum-version detection (optional)
